Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations underpin prices.

Silver.note: Strong solar and industrial demand offsets monetary headwinds.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits align with robust green energy demand.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficits and global nuclear renaissance.

Lithium.note: Near-term supply surplus and slower-than-expected EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Persistent oversupply from Indonesian HPAL projects weighing on prices.

Zinc.note: Mine supply constraints and dropping smelter treatment charges support prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and softening steel demand cap upside.

Coal.note: High global inventories and long-term thermal coal demand destruction.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and gradual recovery in EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Soft steel production in China limits demand growth for alloys.

PGM.note: Tight power supply in South Africa and platinum substitution effects.

Potash.note: Balanced market with steady agricultural demand offsetting supply risks.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and rising green energy demand.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure to copper and iron ore balances sector-specific volatility.
